overview_description.description: Our mission is to accelerate progress toward a smaller, fairer, safer criminal justice system—and to do so at-scale. Recidiviz is a tech startup through and through: we take the speed and problem solving of the tech world and apply it to big public policy challenges where there is huge opportunity for impact. Using modern data infrastructure and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with justice-impacted communities, ecosystem partners, and leaders of the criminal justice system to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from states, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations—including Arnold Ventures, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation—support our work.

product.name: Justice Counts
product.description: A federally funded initiative aimed at making criminal justice data available nationwide, focusing on specific metrics for agencies to share consistently.

product.name: Spotlight
product.description: A public dashboard tool designed to provide insights into prison, parole, and probation data, highlighting racial disparities within the system.

product.name: Data Integration and Analysis Tools
product.description: Tools that aggregate data from disparate sources to provide actionable insights for criminal justice leaders, aiming to support decision-making processes.

product.name: Customized Impact Strategy Development
product.description: Services that involve building relationships with state leadership to understand unique contexts and develop tailored strategies for improving justice system outcomes.
